pages.title: Symmetry Lathe
pages.text: A lathe with an indexing head that stops every 1/k of a turn, and mirrors set round the spindle.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the indexing head's order k and the spindle speed. The blank gets k-fold rotation and k mirrors, a group of order 2k, which must be the recipe's. Spin too fast for a fine head and it shakes apart (k·rpm under 3000).
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Gauge Boson Cluster, Lie Group Lattice, Quaternion Crystal, Symmetry Crystal.
